goal: Backup and purge legacy orphan bots and trades without user_id to optimize 24/7 worker cycle time and achieve pristine multi-tenant database state

contracts.interfaces: SupabaseClient legacy orphan purge and backup methods
function_signatures: purge_orphan_legacy_data(self, backup_dir: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]

execution_steps: Export all legacy bots and bot_trades where user_id IS NULL to backup/legacy_orphan_backup_YYYYMMDD.json
Verify backup integrity (ensure row counts match exactly 20 bots and all legacy bot_trades)
Execute safe deletion of bot_trades where user_id IS NULL via service role credentials
Execute safe deletion of bots where user_id IS NULL via service role credentials
Verify zero orphan bots and zero orphan trades remain in Supabase
Verify 100% data integrity of real users (aldairdunn1, hypedrops.pe, aldairdunn2 bots and trades intact)
acceptance_criteria: A full JSON backup of all orphan bots and trades exists in backup/
Zero rows in bots where user_id IS NULL
Zero rows in bot_trades where user_id IS NULL
Real user bots and trades for aldairdunn1, hypedrops.pe and aldairdunn2 are 100% intact
All unit tests pass with zero regressions

rollback.command: python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; p = Path('backup'); print('Rollback data available in backup directory if needed')"
